name: Grainient-TS-TW
title: Grainient
description: A full-bleed wash of pastel pink, lavender and deep violet that drifts and warps in slow diagonal waves. A light speckled grain sits over everything, giving it a printed, filmic surface.
use: A hero or section needs a soft, colourful backdrop that will not fight the headline.
avoid: You need crisp brand colours or dark mode: the palette is a fixed pastel set and the whole frame stays bright.
a11y: Decorative only and no reduced-motion check, so the drifting colour keeps moving for everyone. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Soft blurred fields of bubblegum pink, lilac and saturated indigo spread across the frame, meeting in feathered diagonal bands. A fine sand-like grain covers the whole surface; there are no hard edges anywhere.
behaves: The colour bands bend and slide against each other at a slow, constant pace, so the composition keeps reshuffling. The grain can be left still or animated to shimmer over the colours.
customise: Three colours, speed, warp strength and frequency, grain amount and animation, zoom, contrast and saturation are all props. The band layout itself is fixed in the shader.
weight: heavy: A WebGL fragment shader runs every frame, though it pauses when offscreen or hidden.
